Just a thought? We could submit and vote on the books that we'd like to read. The mods could start a thread that you join in once you've completed the weekly reading. And then we just discuss.
I like the idea but a week is way too short time for me to read a book. If the time would be more lenient, Im all for it.

I think maybe multiple ones at a time would be fair. All depends on the book and the users I suppose. Maybe have a month long book club and bi monthly? I just really enjoy the discussions and what people get from the book. Their observations and predictions. I've been searching for that kind of thing ever since breaking bad ended.
I think monthly can be good, especially as I would nominate something like Brothers Karamazov and that isnt a book you just swallow in a week nor in two. I do like the idea a lot though.

The beauty of reddit/voat discussion threads is that a user can read through them later and still gain everything. So in the event of a book club thread you would open it early for those who finish early and keep it open afterwards so that users can keep discussing. Spoilers will need moderation of course.

true but I'd like to have a time frame that would guarantee that most could finish the book, even those who have little time to devote for reading, so that everyone can feel they can participate and be included in this and not be excluded because they happen to be slow reader or have life situation that doesnt permit lot of reading. Also, I personally at least dont feel like trying to continue discussion when the initial burst of discussion about the book is over.

There will have to be advanced notice anyways so that users can make arrangements to have copies. Maybe have an a separate book club going on for public domain books so that no matter what users may get a copy.

I didnt talk about getting a copy, I spoke of how long it takes for a person to read a book. For example, no matter how short book, there is no way I can get it read in a week. I will need longer than that.

I got the message. I was merely giving a way for you to be able to read ahead. But if a month is how long you feel comfortable with then a month it is.

And im not saying that we would need to finish a book in a month. It could be a few chapters every couple of weeks. No need to rush someone through a book. And again that's what makes the discussion posts on reddit/voat so great. Take /r/houseofcards for example. The show releases all their episodes(chapters) in advance so the subreddit posts all the discussion threads for each episode in advance so that no matter how fast you complete the series you can contribute to the discussion. We could do the same for the book clubs so that faster readers can contribute earlier and the ones that have busier schedules can still come along and not be left out.

And I'm not in charge of this book club thing. I'm just here to make suggestions. I just hope that one of the mods takes to the idea and we could have our book club. Maybe /v/bookclub will have to suffice.

I am sorry if I sounded hostile, by the way. I just felt that the week you suggested was way short and it seems other people feel the same way. Anyway, I hope this idea gets traction. Maybe someone should just make a starter topic for this, we start nominating books and see if it gets traction and it grows? Something like two to three weeks to nominate books, week or two to vote for book and then time to get the book and month to read, or something like that?

Absolutely. I really want /v/books to have one just for popularity sake. I'm imagining coming to this sub and seeing it stickied at the top with a couple hundred comments with voaters breaking the book down. So maybe the mods could just sticky a link to the /v/bookclub sub and we could have themed book club threads. Like sci fi, mystery, nonfiction, etc,... Nevertheless I'm excited.

At the very least we have /v/bookclub to begin with. They have one for the month of April already and it's public domain.
I vote for The Martian by Andy Weir

I'm not sure I personally have the time (or money haha) to participate regularly in a weekly book club but I like the idea of having a dedicated thread available for the occasions when I would be able to join the discussion. Looking forward to hearing what others think.
Perhaps a monthly sticky here linking to the monthly book pick in /v/bookclub?
I second that. It'll give it the exposure that I'm looking for in an online bookclub.
